# New Features and Enhancements {#sec-new-features}

## {{< var PROGRAM_NAME >}} 1.2.3 {-}
***

### Enhancements {-}

- Added KPI Card
- Choropleth now supports median
- Added **Tell Me** search box for finding and running commands
- Added **Graphs** section to the sidebar, where new graphs are shown by themselves and fill the window
- Added dataset export support (as tab- or comma-separated files)

## {{< var PROGRAM_NAME >}} 1.2.2 {-}
***

### Enhancements {-}

- Added Run Chart
- Added Ishikawa Diagram
- Added Dueling Pie Chart
- Added Pictograph
- Added Du Bois Spiral Chart
- Added Funnel Chart
- Added Waterfall Chart
- Added Bullet Chart
- Added Nightingale Rose Chart
- Added Choropleth
- Added Race Track Chart
- Added Wilmarth Bridge Plot
- Added "Serpentine" features to bar charts
- Added *PowerPoint* exporting
- Added showcasing support to Sankey diagrams
- Added word balloon styles to labels
- Added new shapes:
  - Prohibited sign
  - Pumpkin pie
- Added styling options to pie charts to make them look like:
  - Bagels
  - Pumpkin pies
- Added basic Lua interpreter

## {{< var PROGRAM_NAME >}} 1.2.1 {-}
***

### Enhancements {-}

- Major improvements to stand-alone application
- Added styling option to pie charts to make them look like:
  - Glazed donuts

## {{< var PROGRAM_NAME >}} 1.2.0 {-}
***

### Enhancements {-}

- Alpha release of stand-alone application (`WisteriaDV` target)
- Added Chernoff Faces Plot
- Added Stem & Leaf Plot
- Added PDF export (using *wxPdfDocument*)
- Added basic CSS markup support to labels
- Added *OpenDocument* Spreadsheet importer
- Added new shapes:
  - Tractor
  - Butterfly
  - Star
- Improved *Excel* importer performance
- Likert chart now implicitly uses default response labels on legend (if none are found in dataset)
- Added new dataset join operations (inner join and new left joins)
- Added SVG accessibility support

### Bug Fixes {-}

- Fixed group-label display in heatmaps when data are not sorted by groups

## {{< var PROGRAM_NAME >}} 1.1.0 {-}
***

### Enhancements {-}

- Added Scatter Plot
- Added Bubble Plot
- Added new shapes:
  - Cheese pizza
  - Pepperoni pizza
  - Hawaiian pizza
  - Chocolate chip cookie
  - Coffee shop cup
  - Pill
- Added styling options to pie charts to make them look like:
  - Hawaiian pizzas
  - Mars symbols
  - Venus symbols
  - Chocolate chip cookies
- Added marker effect to bar charts and box plots
- Added pencil effect to bar charts and box plots
- Add pencil style for axis and grid lines
- When using a water color effect for box plots, draw the whisker with the "paint brush" also
- Compatibility change: watermarks are only rendered on print and save now
- `@USER@` placeholder now supported in watermarks
- `@DATETIME@` placeholder now supported in print headers and footers
- Improved layout of watermarks and tilted labels
- Improved the appearance of pie chart's coffee stain style

## {{< var PROGRAM_NAME >}} 1.0.7 {-}
***

### Enhancements {-}

- Added styling options to pie charts to make them look like:
  - Clock faces
  - Cheese pizzas
  - Pepperoni pizzas
  - Coffee rings
- Added feature to waffle chart to override the number of rows in the waffle
- Compatibility change: `IconShape::Dollar` has been renamed to \
  `IconShape::HundredDollarBill`

### Bug Fixes {-}

- Fixed pie chart `UseColorLabels()` function
- Fixed **Save** option not working in canvas context menu

## {{< var PROGRAM_NAME >}} 1.0.6 {-}
***

### Enhancements {-}

- Improved image scaling when loaded via JSON file

## {{< var PROGRAM_NAME >}} 1.0.5 {-}
***

### Enhancements {-}

- Added Waffle Chart
- Added new shapes:
  - Curvy road
  - Pumpkin
  - Jack-o'-lantern
- Added new formulas to JSON syntax:
  - `ADD`
  - `MEDIAN`

## {{< var PROGRAM_NAME >}} 1.0.4 {-}
***

### Enhancements {-}

- Added support for tied games to Win/Loss Sparkline
- Made legend for Win/Loss Sparkline more dynamic
- Improved layout of images embedded in reports
  - Larger images will now be sized properly to the width of the canvas, while maintaining aspect ratio
- Improved layout of empty spacers in reports (will now consume zero size)
- Expanded JSON syntax manual
- JSON syntax manual will now be automatically build via *CMake* (if *Quarto* is installed)

## {{< var PROGRAM_NAME >}} 1.0.3 {-}
***

### Enhancements {-}

- Added Win/Loss Sparkline
- Expanded W-Curve plot to handle 12 levels
- Reference lines can now show their labels on the axes
- Shapes can now be added above a label
- Made color of canvas watermark customizable
- Improved layout of watermarks and rotated text
- Improved deduction of discrete columns when importing data
- Exposed more functionality to JSON syntax
- Expanded and improved the documentation

### Bug Fixes {-}

- Fixed annotations to support floating-point positioning

## {{< var PROGRAM_NAME >}} 1.0.2 {-}
***

### Enhancements {-}

- Added Multi-series Line Plot
  (this allows for plotting multiple data series on a line plot)
- Added sword and Immaculate Heart with sword shapes
- Arrow icons are now customizable for Likert Charts
- Added showcasing option to Lix Gauge
- Added showcasing option to German Lix Gauge
- Improved auto-contrasting graphs with black backgrounds
- All shapes now support non-opaque brushes
- Added currency formatting support to Unix platforms
- Added `Tint()` function
- Optimizations for bar sorting (bar charts)

### Bug Fixes {-}

- Likert Charts
  - Now uses guillemets instead of Unicode arrows
    (this fixes display issues where some fonts don't support those characters)
  - Fixed bar labels erroneously being shown
- Fixed axis brackets in Lix Gauge to be a consistent color

## {{< var PROGRAM_NAME >}} 1.0.1 {-}
***

### Enhancements {-}

- Added Scale Chart
- Added INFLESZ Scale
- Added WebP image support
- DPI resolution for saving images is now customizable
- Added support for adding PNG description when exporting images
- Added showcasing to DB2 plot
- Expanded JSON syntax
- Shapes:
  - Added dollar bill and monitor shapes
  - Force car shape to always be dark blue
  - Improve appearance of some shapes
- Bar charts:
  - Apply opacity to showcased bars' stipple shapes
  - Added option to bar chart showcasing to keep the labels on ghosted bars
  - Bar chart bin labels will now use the precision that the parallel axis uses
  - Improve bar labels to not overlap so often
  - Improve making space for larger bin labels
  - Vertically center bar block decals in vertical bar charts
  - Added reverse arrow bar shape (bar charts)
- Don't automatically add margins to common axes
- Ghost middle labels on pie slice if slice is ghosted
- Added ghosting support to:
  - Bar blocks (in bar charts)
  - Axis points
  - Axis brackets
- Added showcasing to:
  - Line plots
  - Axis points
  - Axis brackets
- Use reverse arrow on Gantt chart if axis is reversed
- Added currency formatting support to Axes (Windows only)
- Added `Wisteria::GetLibraryVersionInfo()`

### Bug Fixes {-}

- Fixed appearance of some shapes for horizontal bars
- Bar charts:
  - Fixed sorting bars with a set of defined labels
  - Fixed decals in vertical bar charts
  - Fixed bar chart blocks getting rounded down to integers
  - Don't return suffix label for bin labels if not displayed
  - Allow finding bar blocks when scale is reversed
- Fixed W-Curve Plot axis labels not being readable
- Fixed `AdjustRangeToLabels()` to work with reversed scale
- Fixed doxygen not being included in `ALL` *CMake* build

## {{< var PROGRAM_NAME >}} 1.0 {-}
***

### Enhancements {-}

- Added JSON syntax for building multi-page reports
- Added numerous vector-based shapes to use as stipples and icons
- Various improvements

## {{< var PROGRAM_NAME >}} 0.9.1 {-}
***

### Enhancements {-}

- Added Linear Regression Roadmap
- Added Pros & Cons Roadmap
- Added Table (i.e., presentation of tabular data, with aggregation and annotation support)
- Added ability to stretch content to fit the entire page when printing
- Simplified layout of canvas rows when they are fitting their content (see `Wisteria::Canvas::CalcRowDimensions()`)
- Added common axis builder helper class
- Line plots can now use categorical or continuous columns for x-axis values
- Added support for aligning pie chart labels flush left or right against the plotting area
- Setting background color of canvas titles now stretches them across the canvas,
  resulting in a banner appearance
- Improved layout of legends appearing above or below a graph

### Bug Fixes {-}

- Fixed pie charts being drawn outside of their plot area under certain circumstances

## {{< var PROGRAM_NAME >}} 0.9 {-}
***

- Initial public release.
